svg.title: Observables legality, accepted-step sampling, support-scoped volume reductions, and provenance
svg.desc: Four-stage Fullmag observable materialization pipeline: (a) adaptive time integration emitting rows only on accepted steps and discarding rejected adaptive trials; (b) planner legality gate validate_executable_outputs rejecting unmaterializable requests instead of emitting silent zeros; (c) discretization-aware field extraction and volume-weighted scalar reductions Q_scalar = sum_{i in Omega_m} w_i q_i excluding FEM airbox elements; (d) provenance-complete Zarr/HDF5 and scalar table artifacts.
svg.text: Observables Pipeline: Accepted-Step Sampling, Legality Gate, and Support Reduction
Fail-closed capability enforcement from adaptive RK steps through QuantityRegistry to provenance-backed artifacts
Rejected RK trials never emit rows/fields
Mutually exclusive step vs. time cadence
Qn = Q[ m(tn), G, M, P ]
Native field support & airbox-excluding weights wi
FDM: wi = Δx Δy Δz | FEM: nodal/quadrature weights
Nonmagnetic airbox potential u does not enter Ek
